The first part of the Oxford English Dictionary is published.
Punxsutawney holds its first Groundhog Day.
Luna 9 makes the first soft landing on the Moon.
Facebook launches from a Harvard dorm room.
Apollo 14 lands; Alan Shepard later hits golf balls on the Moon.
Jack Kilby files a patent for the integrated circuit.
The Beatles arrive in the US for the first time.
The Boy Scouts of America is incorporated.
William Morgan invents volleyball, first called "Mintonette".
Tom and Jerry debut in the cartoon "Puss Gets the Boot".
Nelson Mandela walks free after 27 years in prison.
Charles Darwin and Abraham Lincoln are born on the same day.
ASCAP is founded to protect songwriters' rights.
Voyager 1 takes the "Pale Blue Dot" photo of Earth.
Galileo Galilei is born in Pisa.
Howard Carter opens the sealed burial chamber of Tutankhamun.
Puccini's opera Madama Butterfly premieres in Milan.
Clyde Tombaugh discovers Pluto.
Thomas Edison patents the phonograph.
John Glenn becomes the first American to orbit Earth.
Marx and Engels publish The Communist Manifesto.
Scientists announce Dolly the sheep, the first cloned mammal.
Light from supernova 1987A reaches Earth.
Pope Gregory XIII decrees the Gregorian calendar.
Samuel Colt patents his revolver.
Radar is demonstrated for the first time in Britain.
The UK Labour Party is founded.
The M*A*S*H finale becomes the most-watched US TV episode yet.
Hattie McDaniel becomes the first African American to win an Oscar.
